entries.Title: Classic Car Show Registration
entries.Summary: A premium vintage-Americana multi-step registration form styled after classic 1950s roadside signage. Editable in MegaForm Builder. Features a photographic header banner with a wavy, transparent bottom edge that flows into a warm parchment form body. Deep barn-red and navy accents over cream, with a display-serif heading. [Category: Events · 25 fields · multi-page · uses: Section, Text, Email, Phone, Number, Select]
